title: Hexagon socket head cap screws — head diameter and head height
provenance: fasten.it DIN 912 (DIN EN ISO 4762) norm page
SSR-precision, Bolting Specialist and Engineers Edge DIN 912 tables
notes: All 14 cells verified 2+ sources. Grooved-head variants print larger dk tolerance-tops (13.27/16.27/18.27 at M8/M10/M12) — those are NOT the standard max; the plain-head max equals the values here. The counterbore a hole preset derives from this is head_dia + 0.5 and head_height + 0.2: a Tracer design margin, not a standards figure.
